cases.title: Repair a busy industrial road
cases.question: A fictional community must decide how and when to repair a road used by trucks, workers, and families.

perspectives.title: Family / student
perspectives.priority: Reliable access to schools and care
perspectives.potential_benefit: Safer travel routes and fewer disruptions
perspectives.potential_burden: Construction detours can increase travel time
perspectives.question_to_test: Which routes do children and caregivers actually use?
perspectives.child_lens: Past access barriers, present crossings, future mobility

perspectives.title: Worker / commuter
perspectives.potential_burden: Temporary access disruptions can affect wages
perspectives.question_to_test: When do people travel, and what alternate routes exist?
perspectives.child_lens: Parents may bear shift and childcare disruptions

perspectives.title: Business / freight
perspectives.question_to_test: What are the freight volumes and verified cost exposures?
perspectives.child_lens: Local jobs, air exposure and future business resilience

perspectives.title: Public works / finance
perspectives.priority: Legal authority, useful-life cost and maintenance
perspectives.potential_burden: Other essential projects may face tradeoffs
perspectives.question_to_test: Who owns the road and which funds are legally eligible?
perspectives.child_lens: Long-run safety and intergenerational public cost

perspectives.title: Environmental / neighborhood
perspectives.potential_burden: Work may generate dust, traffic and noise
perspectives.question_to_test: What baseline air/noise readings exist?
perspectives.child_lens: Disproportionate burdens on children close to the route

branches.title: Repair now
branches.child_future: Safer future routes if design works
branches.observable_indicator: Injury data and post-repair maintenance cost

branches.title: Phase repairs and safety controls
branches.potential_benefit: May spread cost and maintain some access
branches.critical_dependency: Verified hazard ranking and monitored controls
branches.child_future: Children may benefit later, but interim risks remain

branches.title: Defer and monitor
branches.downside: Maintenance and safety risks may grow
branches.critical_dependency: Evidence that near-term conditions meet required standards
branches.child_future: Potentially transfers cost and risk to future residents
branches.observable_indicator: Safety inspections and worsening pavement condition

child_impact.past: Review prior road design, historical access and maintenance decisions.
child_impact.present: Evaluate current travel safety, access and displacement of risks.
child_impact.future: Consider 5, 10, 25 and 50-year safety, budgets and mobility.

unknowns: What is the actual maintenance liability?
Are there reliable accident, truck and air-quality measurements?
cases.evidence_note: No actual local position, project-specific evidence or forecast is asserted. These are teaching lenses, not attributed quotes or verified local claims.
source_context: City public works and council archives

cases.title: Should a city support a major employer?
cases.question: A fictional public incentive proposal promises jobs but also requires taxpayer support and new infrastructure.

perspectives.title: Worker / job seeker
perspectives.question_to_test: What pay, benefits and realized employment are documented?
perspectives.child_lens: Parents and future students need accessible career paths

perspectives.title: Taxpayer / household
perspectives.potential_burden: Debt, utility and opportunity costs may be shifted
perspectives.question_to_test: What is authorized versus actually paid?
perspectives.child_lens: Public services used by children compete for resources

perspectives.title: Existing small business
perspectives.question_to_test: Which local suppliers benefit and at what cost?
perspectives.child_lens: Long-term local ownership and apprenticeship opportunities

perspectives.title: Public finance / government
perspectives.question_to_test: What approvals, terms and clawbacks actually exist?
perspectives.child_lens: Who inherits maintenance obligations and costs?

perspectives.title: Neighborhood / environment
perspectives.question_to_test: What independent assessments and mitigation plans exist?
perspectives.child_lens: Long-term water, air and neighborhood conditions

branches.title: Approve conditional support
branches.critical_dependency: Independent financial review, measurable jobs and enforceable terms
branches.child_future: Future children could inherit assets or liabilities

branches.title: Negotiate smaller or different package
branches.potential_benefit: Could reduce exposure and improve conditions
branches.downside: Project might change scope or location
branches.critical_dependency: Evidence of counteroffers and legal eligibility
branches.child_future: Could balance educational investment and employment
branches.observable_indicator: Signed revised terms and realized outcomes

branches.title: Decline support
branches.critical_dependency: Credible no-action baseline and legal review
branches.child_future: Other public priorities could retain resources

child_impact.past: Identify older commitments and whether earlier benefits materialized.
child_impact.present: Separate proposed, authorized, obligated and spent money.
child_impact.future: Model job durability, fiscal liabilities, skills and environmental burden.

unknowns: Do the projected jobs have verified baselines?
Who pays for operations and maintenance?
cases.evidence_note: No actual local position, project-specific evidence or forecast is asserted. These are teaching lenses, not attributed quotes or verified local claims.
source_context: City Council finance and agenda records
Audited financial statements and signed agreements

cases.title: What should happen at an old industrial site?
cases.question: A fictional former industrial parcel has incomplete historical records and disputed ideas for future use.

perspectives.title: Long-term resident / oral historian
perspectives.potential_burden: Memories may lack independently dated corroboration
perspectives.question_to_test: What historical records confirm or contextualize oral accounts?
perspectives.child_lens: Children inherit both place memory and exposure concerns

perspectives.title: Public health / clinician
perspectives.question_to_test: What samples and pathways are scientifically valid?
perspectives.child_lens: Age-specific exposure pathways and future health

perspectives.title: Property owner / developer
perspectives.question_to_test: What land-use and cleanup standards actually apply?
perspectives.child_lens: Future residents need durable protections

perspectives.title: Child / family advocate
perspectives.question_to_test: Are exposure and accessibility independently reviewed?
perspectives.child_lens: Place-sensitive, age-specific and multigenerational impacts

perspectives.title: Archivist / researcher
perspectives.question_to_test: How do we reconcile conflicting parcel names and dates?
perspectives.child_lens: Preserve honest history without stigma

branches.title: Investigate before major reuse
branches.observable_indicator: Verified sampling, record access and correction events

branches.title: Introduce bounded interim protections
branches.downside: May affect land access and costs
branches.critical_dependency: Clear legal authority and proportionate safeguards
branches.child_future: Near-term precaution while preserving future options

branches.title: Proceed with conditioned reuse
branches.critical_dependency: Demonstrated regulatory, technical and human clearance

child_impact.past: Recover prior land use, permits, historic mapping and residents’ accounts.
child_impact.present: Assess known and unknown current exposure without inferring diagnosis.
child_impact.future: Track stewardship duties, groundwater, housing and child-health horizons.

unknowns: Are parcel identities and historic uses verified?
Who is legally responsible for follow-up?
cases.evidence_note: No actual local position, project-specific evidence or forecast is asserted. These are teaching lenses, not attributed quotes or verified local claims.
source_context: Environmental agencies and qualified historic archives
County parcel and land use records

cases.title: A viral claim about a local official
cases.question: A fictional social post makes a serious accusation. Many repost it, but the original evidence is unclear.

perspectives.title: Resident / reader
perspectives.potential_burden: Amplifying unverified accusations can harm people
perspectives.question_to_test: Which documents independently support the claim?
perspectives.child_lens: Families and children may be harmed by false allegations

perspectives.title: Reporter / editor
perspectives.question_to_test: What primary records and direct responses have been checked?
perspectives.child_lens: Long-term trust in local information

perspectives.title: Person named in claim
perspectives.question_to_test: Has the subject been afforded appropriate response?
perspectives.child_lens: Avoid exposing the person’s children or household

perspectives.title: Records custodian
perspectives.question_to_test: What is the original signed record and its revision history?
perspectives.child_lens: Future use of records requires privacy safeguards

perspectives.title: Teacher / youth educator
perspectives.potential_burden: Students may mistake repetition for proof
perspectives.question_to_test: Can we teach with fictional examples rather than real names?
perspectives.child_lens: Protect learner identity and emotional safety

branches.title: Reshare immediately
branches.potential_benefit: May spread an important concern if accurate
branches.downside: Could amplify misinformation and privacy harm
branches.child_future: Children may inherit lasting digital harm

branches.title: Verify then contextualize
branches.critical_dependency: Primary documents and meaningful response opportunity

branches.title: Pause amplification and seek records
branches.observable_indicator: New original evidence and response records

child_impact.past: Recover original posting time, context and older corrections.
child_impact.present: Distinguish reposts from independent sources and avoid doxxing.
child_impact.future: Observe whether corrections reach the original audience over time.

unknowns: Is there even one authenticated original record?
Are reposts mistakenly counted as corroboration?
Would publication expose a private family?
